findings.title: Pass the selected log byte limit to the output truncation helper
findings.body: The selected presentation.maxLogBytes controls the Kubernetes request and reported limitBytes, but logObservation still truncates at a hard-coded 64 KiB. With maxLogBytes=100, the requested sentinel byte can be returned as log content and truncated remains false; with maxLogBytes above 65536, available logs are still cut at 64 KiB. Pass the captured limit into logObservation so the actual output bound and truncation evidence match the selected policy.

overall_explanation: The log presentation budget is not applied by the actual output truncation consumer, causing incorrect limits and truncation metadata for nondefault policies. This assessment is based on the supplied source; tests, Helm rendering, deployment, and paid model evaluations were not run.
